shared_files.refresh.py:
import boto3
table = boto3.resource('dynamodb').Table('customers')
def run():
    page = table.scan()
    process(page['Items'])
    while 'LastEvaluatedKey' in page:
        page = table.scan(ExclusiveStartKey=page['LastEvaluatedKey'])
        process(page['Items'])

expected.description: The unchanged full-table refresh is scheduled every minute instead of daily.
